Nomination and Remuneration Committee:
As per provisions under SEBI Regulations, the committee should meet at least once
in every year. However, there was no meeting of the committee held during the year
under review, since there was no specific agenda item for deliberation in line with the
terms of reference of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee.

Risk Management Committee:
The Committee did not meet at least twice during the year under review, as required
under the provisions of the Regulations.
